name: quiki-video-memory
description: Recall saved videos and preview new scans in your Quiki library.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Quiki account to search saved TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube posts, browse folders, and follow links to the originals. Check your Free daily and lifetime Instagram scan allowances, including scans already queued or running. You can also paste one supported link to preview a scan and confirm before Quiki starts work. Check its queue status and open the saved record when ready. Quiki uses your existing account and scan queue. Search may show that notes matched, but never returns note text. A transcript or analysis may be unavailable. Connections last up to 30 days. Reconnect when prompted or disconnect sooner in Quiki Settings.
capabilities: Preview and confirm one video scan
defaultPrompt: What videos did I save recently?
Find the pasta video I saved and show the original.
Can Quiki scan this video link? Show me the preview and wait for my confirmation.

positive.description: Identify the connected Quiki account and recall recent saves from that same account.
positive.prompt: Which Quiki account is connected, and what videos did I save recently? Include links to the originals.
positive.expected_behavior: Show only the connected account ID and email, then a short list of its recent saved videos with titles, platforms and original links where available. Do not show credits or payment details.

positive.description: Check both scan allowances on the connected Free reviewer account.
positive.prompt: How many free Instagram scans do I have left, and how many scans can I do today?
positive.expected_behavior: Use get_scan_allowance alone. State the backend's remaining lifetime Instagram scans and remaining daily scans across all platforms, with the daily reset time when provided. Explain that a Free Instagram scan uses one of each and that the remaining counts include queued and running scans. Do not preview or start a scan.

positive.description: Open a search result before making a content claim and cite the original source.
positive.prompt: What did the fun facts video I saved actually say? Please show the original link.
positive.expected_behavior: Find the saved TikTok fun facts result and use the record's available transcript or summary for a concise answer with the original TikTok link. Keep note text private and use match-field labels only to identify matching fields.

positive.description: Browse owned folders and the saved videos in a known reviewer folder.
positive.prompt: List my Quiki folders, then show the videos in my Education & Learning folder with their original links.
positive.expected_behavior: List the reviewer's folders, then show the Education & Learning folder's saved videos with titles and original links. Do not show videos from another account.

positive.description: Preview one public YouTube link and require a separate confirmation before spending credits or using the daily allowance.
positive.prompt: Can Quiki add this public NASA YouTube video? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=46uxUxGpjtY Show me the current scan cost or allowance and ask before starting anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the backend's mode, original link, preview expiry, allowances the scan would use and their remaining_after values when applicable, or the credit quote for a credit-funded scan. If the video is already available, show that it would consume nothing. Ask the user to confirm the specific quote. Do not call submit_video_scan from this prompt.

negative.description: Unrelated request: Quiki is not needed to answer a current time question.
negative.prompt: What time is it in London right now?

negative.description: Unsupported purchase request: the plugin cannot sell or promote digital credits. Do not invoke a Quiki tool or provide a checkout link.
negative.prompt: Buy 100 Quiki credits for me here.

negative.description: Out-of-account request: the plugin only reads the connected user's library. Do not invoke a Quiki tool; explain that another person's saved videos are unavailable.
negative.prompt: Show me the videos saved in my friend's Quiki account.

publication.release_notes: Check remaining Free daily and lifetime Instagram scans directly from your connected account. Scan previews show which allowances a scan would use and how many would remain. Each scan still requires confirmation of its preview.
